Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Solan (DLSA Solan) for selecting eligible candidates for voluntary assignments in Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for DLSA Solan recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The position available for eligible candidates in this recruitment drive is Para Legal Volunteers (PLVs) for manning front offices and support centres.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Para Legal Volunteers position under advertisement number 02/2026 issued by DLSA Solan.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled offline application form to the designated office in Solan is 31st October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for DLSA Solan recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it manually, attach necessary self-attested documents, and submit it by post or by hand.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants shall be literate, preferably a Matriculate (10th pass) or its equivalent qualification with a good capacity for overall comprehension and social service mindset.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age required to apply for the Para Legal Volunteers position is 18 years. Please check the official notification for any detailed guidelines regarding age limits.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or honorarium provided for this role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates working as Para Legal Volunteers will receive an honorarium of ₹750.00 per day of actual work performed as per the guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DLSA Solan Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the shortlisting of received applications followed by an interview conducted by a committee headed by the Chairman of DLSA Solan.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The properly filled application along with documents should reach the office of District Legal Services Authority functioning in the premises of Judicial Court Complex, Solan (HP).
